note: 14/08 F-SCAN: scored F3 (US light-inventory / domestic POD hybrid). Sits between Hunthide F1 and Marsh Wear F5 - the middle tier the rubric needed to prove it is a scale, not a binary. Paid discount-code hook + 3-4 day processing = holds some stock but is not running a real returns operation.

FULFILLMENT TIER (F1-F5) - method added 14/08 at user request, to answer 'who in this lane is dropshipping'. WHY IT MATTERS: inventory commitment = response latency. A POD competitor clones a species design in days at zero risk; a real-inventory brand commits 8-16 weeks ahead. So a lane's window is a function of WHO is in it, not HOW MANY. MEASURE, never guess, and only after opening BOTH the shipping and the returns page. PRIMARY SIGNAL = time-to-door (processing + transit, in business days): >=15 -> F1, 8-14 -> F2, 5-7 -> F3, 2-4 -> F4, same/next-day processing -> F5. SECOND SIGNAL = returns: defect-only or no-size-returns -> F1-F2 (a POD seller cannot restock); free returns / satisfaction guarantee -> F4-F5. THIRD = explicit 'made to order' / 'print on demand' wording -> F1 regardless of stated times. SUPPORTING ONLY (never conclusive alone): virtual-office/registered-agent suite address, no return address, discount ladder Buy2/Buy5, never-out-of-stock across a large catalogue, mockup-only imagery with no field photography, cm-first size chart. FORBIDDEN INFERENCES: do NOT infer F from price (Duck Camp discounts hats to $25 and is a real brand); do NOT infer F from whether they run ads; unopened policy pages -> write 'F?' and move on. VERIFIED ANCHORS 14/08: Hunthide F1 (made-to-order, 13-20 business days, defect-only returns) - Huntdad F3 (7-10 business days, US-only, no POD language) - Marsh Wear F5 (same-day processing, free returns).

Terrabound Outdoor. Processing '1-3 business days' + delivery '3-6 business days following dispatch' = 4-9 bds total -> Signal 1 scores F3. Company address 61 Whitechapel High St, London E1 7PE (virtual office). DOWNGRADED to F2 by new Signal 2b - see terrabound_returns.

PAPER RETURNS POLICY - the case that broke the old rubric. Words say F4-F5: '30-day return window', accepts change-of-mind AND sizing, 'no restocking fees'. Economics say F1-F2: return address is No. 2 Yuangtong Express, No. 409, Suxi Yiwu Town, Zhejiang 310000, CHINA, and the customer pays 'approximately GBP 15-35 per parcel'. On a ~$35 hoodie the return costs as much as the item. The policy exists to be READ, not USED.

AMENDMENT to F_SCORE_RUBRIC, Signal 2 (returns policy). Generous return wording counts as an F4-F5 signal ONLY IF the return address is in the SAME COUNTRY as the selling market. If the return address is overseas OR the buyer-paid return shipping is >=40% of the item price, treat the policy as 'defect-only' and cap the brand at F2 regardless of wording. Discovered via terrabound_returns 14/08: old rubric scored it F3-F4, corrected reading is F2. SELF-APPLY: the same test applies to GritFell. The question to ask is NOT 'do we accept size exchanges' but 'where does the return go and who pays'. If GritFell returns route to Vietnam at buyer cost, GritFell sits in the same box as Terrabound.

ROSTER HYGIENE. If the SAME ad_creative_link_title appears under >=2 unrelated page names in one Ad Library query, mark them ad_farm: one operator running shell pages, NOT N new competitors. Do NOT add to brands[]; add to noise_pages_seen[] and DO count them as lane saturation pressure. Without this the 'new competitor' counter inflates on shell pages. First catch 14/08: 'Men's Ventilated Fast Dry Hoodie Sun Hoodie' under Masterpiecei / Beyonddraw.BE / Emboadlie.xs01.

PRODUCT DISCOVERY GATE. Every candidate product must pass 4 of 5. P1 MARGIN >=55% at the lane's real price (rule S6; below that there is no money to fund Priority or a US warehouse). P2 CARRIES SPECIES ART - is there a flat area big enough to tell a species + a moment? A product that cannot carry art is being sold the way a POD farm sells it, with no moat. P3 NO SIZE - one-size or no size chart; size exchange is the largest hidden cost in cross-border shipping. P4 US PATH EXISTS - at least one US-side fulfilment source, else the product is stuck at F1-F2 forever. P5 DEMAND IS MEASURABLE with a real sensor, see DEMAND_SENSOR_MAP. Scored 14/08: Mug 5/5, Canvas 5/5, Garden Flag 5/5, Beanie 4/5, Whiskey Glass 4/5, Blanket 3/5, Socks 2/5, T-shirt 2/5, ready-made hunting apparel 1/5.

METHOD ERROR CAUGHT 14/08. Meta Ad Library is the WRONG sensor for gift / decor / drinkware. Queries 'engraved whiskey glass hunting' returned 4 ads (all noise) and 'duck hunting decor' returned 8 (mostly a barrel reseller; one real signal - Huntdad now running 'Duck Polo Shirt'). Reading that as 'empty lane = opportunity' is a ONE-DIRECTIONAL error that always sounds like good news. Nobody buys an engraved duck glass from a Facebook ad; they search Etsy and Amazon. SENSOR MAP: branded apparel/hats -> Meta Ad Library. Gift, decor, drinkware, flags, canvas -> Etsy search + competitor catalogue. Hard gear (knives, lights, bags) -> Amazon + competitor catalogue. RULE: never conclude 'lane is empty' from a Meta query on a non-apparel product. If the right sensor is unavailable in the run, mark P5 as NOT YET MEASURED and do not green-light.

CONCLUSION: the stack is essentially all-POD, so a real dropship leg has only two narrow doors - and the valuable one is not a product source at all, it is the US 3PL.

THE F-TIER UNLOCK, and it was already in the user's own supplier list. FASTEX FULFILLMENT: 'Dich vu luu kho, xu li don va ship noi dia My' = US warehousing + order processing + US domestic shipping. This supersedes the 13/08 action item 'ask TNT Embroidery about a US return address'. MODEL: bulk-embroider PROVEN best-sellers at Minh Theu VN, ship one large lot to FASTEX, fulfil domestically in 2-4 days = F4 with a real US return address and real size exchanges; long-tail SKUs keep running POD direct from VN at F2. This is the only path in the data that lifts GritFell F2 -> F4/F5 without dropping the art, changing factory, or cutting price. CONDITION: it requires working capital for the stocked leg, which pure POD does not - so ONLY for SKUs with proven sales, NEVER a new SKU. OPEN QUESTION, highest priority: FASTEX storage fee + pick&pack fee + do they accept customer returns.

Xiamen Yuelei Sports - the only genuine hunting-apparel manufacturer among 40 suppliers. MOQ 50 for 3D (that is stocking, not dropshipping); stock 1 pc for 2D. VERDICT: do NOT resell their ready-made hunting apparel - it carries no art, has no moat (any shop can buy the same), and it contradicts GritFell's positioning. P-SCORE 1/5. THE REAL VALUE IS AS A BLANK SOURCE: purpose-built hunting blanks (not Gildan) that GritFell embroiders are a PHYSICAL barrier and would satisfy the T+1 condition in the arbitrage gate. ASK: will they sell blanks in small quantity without MOQ.

HIGHEST PRIORITY OPEN RISK. US customs changed and every COGS figure in this project predates it. (1) 29/08/2025 the $800 de minimis duty-free exemption ended for ALL countries. (2) Federal Register rule effective 24/06/2026 suspends de minimis INDEFINITELY; shipments must use formal/informal entry (Type 11 for <=$2,500). That rule EXCLUDES international postal network - postal is a separate concurrent rulemaking that has NOT been verified here. (3) 24/07/2026 Section 301 forced-labour tariffs took effect on 60 economies; VIETNAM AND CHINA both pay the flat 12.5% with no MFN offset (Global Trade Alert final action). IMPACT: Minh Theu VN is labelled 'DDP - Minh Theu VN' in 3 sheets of the catalogue file, so duty is nominally the supplier's. BUT the price list stamps are '1st item (+1$) 23.3.2026' and '14.8.26 doi chat', i.e. the quoted prices predate the 24/07 tariff. If DDP no longer holds, or if per-parcel brokerage ($10-20/parcel per Stord) applies, hat COGS moves from $14.50 to $25-35 and the $34 hat margin falls from 57.4% to between -3% and 26%. THE ONE QUESTION: 'after 24/07/2026 is the Ship US quote still DDP, and has the 12.5% been priced in?' Until answered, every margin in the 14/08 documents is ASSUMPTION, not fact.

SUPERSEDES P_SCORE_RUBRIC (v1). v1 had a structural flaw: it scored margin first and demand last, which is still supply-side thinking. v2 is sequential and fails fast. GATE 0 DEMAND PROOF - real buyer evidence (reviews, sales rank, repeated complaints). 'No competitor found' is NOT demand evidence. Sensor must match product type per DEMAND_SENSOR_MAP. Fail = STOP, do not even compute COGS. GATE 1 LEGAL/IP CLEAN - no third-party camo patterns or marks, no shipping-restricted goods, nothing over 10 lbs, no hazmat, no electronics needing certification. GATE 2 COGS IS CURRENT (NEW) - price must be confirmed AFTER 24/07/2026 with DDP-vs-DDU stated and the 12.5% duty incidence named; anything older is marked NOT VERIFIED and cannot be used. GATE 3 GRITFELL FIT - carries species art, no size, tells a story. GATE 4 US PATH - a US fulfilment source exists; if own-warehouse, is volume above ~100 orders/month. MANDATORY SELF-CHECK each scoring: (a) was my sensor right for this product type, (b) which sources were BLOCKED this run - blocked is not empty, (c) is this a supply number (listings) or a demand number (reviews/sales), (d) how many days old is this COGS.

Standing list of errors this project has actually made or nearly made. MINE: (1) SUPPLY-SIDE BIAS - twice searched the client's own supplier files and called it market discovery; availability heuristic. (2) TARIFF BLINDNESS - see TARIFF_REGIME_2026. (3) WRONG SENSOR - used Meta Ad Library to measure gift/decor demand. (4) 3PL FLOOR IGNORED - pitched a US warehouse without stating ShipBob $275/mo and ShipMonk $250/mo minimums; break-even is ~80-110 orders/month. DATA MISREADS: (5) 'not found' vs 'blocked' - on 14/08 Reddit (403), Amazon (robots), Etsy search (robots), Pinterest Trends and CJdropshipping were ALL blocked; absence of results was access failure, not absence of market. (6) listings = SUPPLY, reviews = DEMAND, never conflate; Etsy review counts aggregate variants. (7) Etsy 'Star Seller' is a service-quality badge, not a sales badge. (8) steep '70% off' pricing is an oversupply tell, not a demand tell. (9) Wholesale Survival Club and Tactical Dropship share phone 760-994-0710 - one operator, two storefronts, not two options. (10) TikTok Shop's 'viral' label is TikTok's own taxonomy, not organic virality. (11) recency trap - Catchin' Deers (2016), openseason (2013), eMinnow (2017) all resurface as 'new 2026'. MARKET MISREADS: (12) outdoor is NOT growing - licensed anglers -8.5% 2021-23, tackle -8%, powerboats -8-10%, hunting participation -10.5% and fishing -15% vs 1990s, yet total spend is still $122B: fewer participants, undiminished wallet, so growth must come from share and margin. (13) the heritage-camo trend is largely Mossy Oak / Realtree IP and is already forbidden by the project prompt - ride the aesthetic via historical WWII frogskin or abstract 'blob camo', never the trademarked patterns. (14) strongest verified unmet need (dog hunting vest chafing at the front leg/shoulder, real injuries, DIY fixes) is NOT POD-able - wanting it does not mean we can make it.

DEMAND-FIRST SWEEP RESULTS. Etsy /market/ pages opened (search blocked, so no listing totals): personalized fishing lure keychain ~$12.66 / 64.5k reviews; hunting-humour doormat $14.99 / 133.3k; LEATHER HUNTING LOG BOOK $49 / 20.9k; carved wood 'Established' cabin sign $69 / 17.1k; oval deer metal sign $18 / 25.4k; ENGRAVED AMMO CAN $35 / 16.1k (thinner supply); species-specific tumblers $21-25 / 1.2-5.2k. THE CLEAREST WHITE SPACE: koozies (47.7k reviews) and bar mats (10.3k) have proven demand but the top listings are WEDDING/GROOMSMAN themed - the hunting/fishing version barely exists, and Gooten makes can coolers IN THE USA (verified). Etsy's own Spring/Summer 2026 trend report names 'Dear Diary' (analog revival, leather journals/keepsakes) which matches the hunting log book data - rare case of platform-declared trend and sales data agreeing. Mainstream Etsy/Printify 2026 trend content does not cover the men's hunting/fishing gift niche at all. FORUM UNMET NEEDS (opened and read): dog vest chafing at front-leg/shoulder (strongest, multiple brands, real injuries, DIY workarounds); decoy line tangling; hunting gloves warmth-vs-trigger-feel; rubber-only landing nets called 'trampoline nets'; blind bags (3 forums, titles only); cellular trail cam subscription backlash. REDDIT WAS 100% BLOCKED (403 search and fetch) - the primary target of the sweep returned nothing and that is an access gap, not a finding.

NEW SOURCING ROUTES beyond the existing 40. US OUTDOOR WHOLESALE (best find): CWR Wholesale Distribution - 300+ brands, NJ+FL warehouses, NO stated minimum, flat shipping from $9.95, offers dropshipping, dealer portal with data export/FTP. US Direct -> Sportsman's Supply - 300+ brands, 15,000 items, Missouri warehouse, requires EIN + state resale certificate, self-discloses filtering out 70-90% of catalogue (firearms, 10+ lbs, fraud-risk). Doba - 421 hunting/fishing SKUs US-stocked, 2-3 bd, pricing behind login. CAUTION: Wholesale Survival Club and Tactical Dropship share phone 760-994-0710 = same operator. DROPSHIP PLATFORMS WITH US WAREHOUSES: Zendrop (1 CA centre, 5-8d US / 10-15d CN, branding $2-4/unit at MOQ 100-200, plans $0/59/79/199 per month); Spocket (US/EU suppliers, 2-5d); Sup Dropshipping (US+CN, 3-10d US). CJdropshipping BLOCKED BY BOT-CHECK - catalogue depth unverified. US 3PL REAL COSTS: ShipBob $275/mo minimum, pick&pack $2.50-3.50/order, storage $5/mo bin to $40/mo pallet; ShipMonk $250/mo minimum, ~$7.70-10.70 per order all-in at 300 orders/mo. Break-even roughly 80-110 orders/month. NEW POD FORMATS: Gooten can coolers/koozies MADE IN USA (verified, 3 sizes, sublimation); Printify metal signs (aluminium, no MOQ, 2-7 bd, up to 46% bulk discount at 20 units). NOT AVAILABLE at major POD platforms: UPF performance fishing shirts, waxed canvas, bar mats - these need specialty suppliers.

2026 DIRECTION. RISING: heritage/vintage camo reissues - Mossy Oak Bottomland/Greenleaf, Realtree Advantage Classic, Trebark, sold as streetwear; Mossy Oak president Bill Sugg: 'it's about more than just blending in. It's a badge people are wearing.' DECOY Apparel Co (already in roster) is building a brand on WWII frogskin, $35-200+. Also rising: 'blob camo' (abstract, non-representational, fashion-forward, named in 2026 headwear trend reporting); natural materials in casual pieces (washed cotton, corduroy, seersucker); accent colours (orange, cobalt) on neutral builds; merino / quiet fabric across all price tiers. Kifaru launched its first apparel line 05/03/2026 deliberately in SOLID colours, no camo, for cross-kit modularity. IP TRAP: the heritage-camo trend IS largely Mossy Oak and Realtree intellectual property, already forbidden by the project prompt - the legal routes are historical WWII frogskin and abstract blob camo. PAST PEAK: gorpcore (brands now running ANTI-gorpcore campaigns, a late-cycle marker); loud western (rhinestone/fringe) shifting to stealth western; casual recreational fishing and powerboats contracting, with kayak and forward-facing sonar the resilient pockets. title: DESKTOP SOCIAL FETCH - gritfell-social-fetch.json
note: PC-side fetch of 4 sources the cloud sandbox is blocked from (reddit.com, youtube.com, suggestqueries.google.com, trends.google.com - all return PROXY-blocked from cloud, re-verified 17/08). Sources: (1) reddit /r/<sub>/top.json?t=week over 12 subs mapped to SN1 waterfowl / SN2 freshwater / SN3 inshore / SN4 big game / gundogs; (2) youtube channel RSS for 5 outdoor channels; (3) google autocomplete over 18 seeds - what people ACTUALLY type; (4) google trends US RSS. NO API KEY, NO LOGIN. This is UNAUTHENTICATED public-JSON scraping, not the Reddit API. KNOWN FRAGILITY: reddit rate-limits unauthenticated callers aggressively (HTTP 429) and may 403 a generic User-Agent; the script sends a descriptive research UA and sleeps 2.0s between subs. If reddit hardens further, the correct upgrade is a registered Reddit app (client_id/secret, OAuth script-type token) - NOT faster retries. Script always exits 0: social is a SUPPLEMENTARY source and must never block the push of gritfell-live-fetch.json (97 SKU + policies), which is the mandatory one.

title: RULE - a failed fetch is NOT a zero demand reading
note: BLIND SPOT GUARD, companion to DEMAND_SENSOR_MAP. Every producer file carries an "errors" array. When a source appears EMPTY, the bot MUST first check whether that source has an entry in "errors". If it does, the correct reading is NO DATA (unknown), never NO DEMAND (zero). Concretely: reddit {} + errors[{kind:reddit, code:'HTTP 429'}] means Reddit rate-limited us, it does NOT mean the sub-niche is quiet. Any P_SCORE_V2 Gate 0 (demand proof) verdict resting on a source that is listed in "errors" is INVALID and must be reported as 'demand unverified - sensor failed' rather than scored. Same rule applies to gritfell-live-fetch.json: a brand with a fetch error is not a brand with no products. This is the exact trap the 14/08 Meta Ad Library reading fell into (4 and 8 ads read as 'empty lane' when the sensor was simply wrong for the category).
